description: This PHP source file defines the RouteManager class within the OrangeHRM framework, responsible for loading and managing route configurations from YAML files for plugins in the application.

classes.name: RouteManager
classes.description: A class that manages the retrieval and caching of route configurations, loading plugin routes from YAML files.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Returns the collection of routes, loading and caching them on the first call by reading plugin route configurations.
